# The parity set: the fixed Board-and-Sequence set `cargo test` and the built wasm
# are both solved on (§5.4's "native and wasm agree exactly on every score").
#
# One case per line, `seed pieces cap goal beam`. The Board and the Sequence are
# not stored here because they are a function of `(seed, pieces, cap)` by §5.5–5.8:
# both targets generate them with the same committed generator, which is what makes
# this a fixed set rather than a copy of one frame.
#
# The set is chosen for what the Move list can reveal about scores, since the ABI
# carries no score of its own (§4): Beam width 1 makes the search a greedy arg-max,
# so a score that differs by a single unit changes the play; width 8 lets a
# one-unit difference reorder a Layer's cut; and the last case is a lost Solve, so
# the parity check covers "no answer" as well as an answer.
#
# This is the ticket-05 score-level fixture. §9.2's 100-seed native/wasm gate is
# ticket 09's harness, built on the same comparison.
0 24 7 6 8
42 24 7 6 8
7 24 7 6 4
11 30 7 8 1
3 5 7 8 25
